Handoff written to [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).

**Root cause: `dep-4471` set `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `true`.** Each request now grabs its own connection. The pool of 20 cannot keep up.

Impact ran `02:14:18Z` to at least `03:59:27Z`. 530 of 636 requests failed, an 83% error rate. Five paths hit, checkout among them. `/health` stayed 200 the whole time, so the outage hid from health checks.

Next: roll back `dep-4471`, or flip that one key to `false` and reload.
